sourceRefs.locator: 5.48.1–3: Jovius meets Alaric at Ariminum and sends demands including annual gold, grain and settlement to the emperor

note.de: Der Kaiserhof in Ravenna war am Fortgang der Gespräche beteiligt. Zosimos beschreibt den Briefwechsel zwischen Jovius und Honorius.
note.en: The imperial court at Ravenna shaped the talks. Zosimus describes an exchange of letters between Jovius and Honorius.
